## Original article text

````markdown
This event type triggers for a player when they are credited for an elimination and the `Conditions` evaluate to `True`.

#### Arguments

*  [Team](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/team) - The team(s) checked by the event.
*  [Player](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/player) - The player(s) checked by the event based on slot number or hero.

#### Contextual Values

*  [Event Player](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/event+player) - The player that triggered the event.
*  [Event Damage](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/event+damage) - The amount of damage dealt by `Event Player`.
*  [Attacker](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/attacker) - The player earning the elimination credit. In this context, it has the same value as `Event Player`.
*  [Victim](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/victim) - The credited elimination victim.
*  [Event Was Critical Hit](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/event+was+critical+hit) - Whether the inflicted damage was a headshot.
*  [Event Ability](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/event+ability) - The ability used by the `Attacker`.
*  [Event Direction](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/event+direction) - The incoming direction from the source of damage to the `Victim`.
````
